About the release

The 2026 Topps NOW® Road to Opening Day program features team sets from all 30 MLB® clubs – and brand new for 2026 – an Autograph Collector’s Box!

Look for on-card autographs numbered to 99 or less and dual autographs limited to 5 copies or less!

Purchasers of this set have the chance to earn Topps NOW® bonus cards! The following milestones trigger an exclusive bonus card(s) order over the course of the 2026 season (Opening Day through World Series)

Team's player hits for cycle
Team's player hits 3 HRs in a game
Team's pitcher throws 15 Ks in a game
Team's individual pitcher throws a no-hitter or perfect game

About the brand

Since 2017, Topps NOW® has started up each Major League Baseball season with Road to Opening Day. These collectible team sets feature top stars and rookies, along with new talent acquired over the offseason – signaling that Opening Day is just around the corner!
